text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Biwa Hayahide—

At the end of her gaze was a claw machine. 
Inside were plushies modeled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When we were young, Brian and I used to 
have matching stuffed animals.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I can't even picture her 
holding a plushie, but..."

Watching her gaze nostalgically at the 
plushie, an idea came to mind.
choice_data_list:
Want to try holding it again after so 
long?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The current me, holding a plushie...? Hmm, 
an amusing thought.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It might be nice to bask in childhood 
memories. First, though, I need to win a 
plushie.
choice_data_list: In that case, leave it to me!
In that case, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ho, looks like you're already fired up and 
ready to go. In that case, let us see what 
you're capable of.
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
